mapper.select: SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM material_receiving WHERE receive_date > #{date} GROUP BY material_code
SELECT u.material_code AS "code", SUM(u.qty_used) AS "qty" FROM production_material_usage u JOIN production_schedule s ON u.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.schedule_date > #{date} GROUP BY u.material_code
SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(COALESCE(in_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(out_qty, 0)) AS "qty" FROM material_stock_movement WHERE SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) > #{date} GROUP BY material_code

SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(COALESCE(new_stock_qty, 0) - COALESCE(old_stock_qty, 0)) AS "qty" FROM material_stock_schedule WHERE applied = 1 AND effective_date > #{date} GROUP BY material_code
SELECT warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_nm, warehouse_id
SELECT warehouse_nm FROM tb_warehouse WHERE factory_code = 'F001' AND plant_code = 'P001' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND default_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, warehouse_id LIMIT 1
